stem: One candidate plant ranks highest for vigor but grew in the brightest position in the room. What is the strongest next step before treating it as genetically superior breeding stock?
choices: Compare environmental records or replicated/progeny performance so positional advantage is not mistaken for inherited superiority
Select it immediately because the highest observed phenotype always has the highest breeding value
Discard records for rejected plants because only winners matter in selection
Declare the line stable after this single observation
rationale: Environmental advantage can mimic genetic superiority. Repeatable phenotyping, environmental context, replication, population records, and progeny testing strengthen evidence that a selected phenotype has useful inherited value.
